children.name: Todea
children.description: Todea — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Todea barbara
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Trop. & S. Africa, E. & SE. Australia, New Zealand. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Todea papuana
children.description: The native range of this species is Papua New Guinea.

children.name: Leptopteris
children.description: Leptopteris — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Leptopteris × intermedia
children.description: The native range of this species is New Zealand. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Leptopteris alpina
children.description: The native range of this species is Maluku (Seram) to New Guinea. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Leptopteris fraseri
children.description: The native range of this species is NE. Queensland, E. New South Wales. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Leptopteris hymenophylloides
children.description: The native range of this species is New Zealand, Chatham Is.. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Leptopteris laxa
children.description: The native range of this species is Bismarck Arch. to Solomon Is.. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Leptopteris moorei
children.description: The native range of this species is Lord Howe I.. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Leptopteris superba
children.description: The native range of this species is New Zealand. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Leptopteris wilkesiana
children.description: The native range of this species is New Guinea to SW. Pacific. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Osmunda
children.description: Osmunda — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Osmunda × intermedia
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda × mildei
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. China. It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda × nipponica
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Japan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda × ruggii
children.description: The native range of this species is NC. & E. U.S.A.. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda acuta
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. India. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Osmunda angustifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. China to Indo-China. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Osmunda banksiifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. China to Kamchatka and W. & C. Malesia. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda claytoniana
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & E. Canada to NC. & E. U.S.A.. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda herbacea
children.description: The native range of this species is Philippines (Mindanao).

children.name: Osmunda hybrida
children.description: The native range of this species is Indo-China.

children.name: Osmunda japonica
children.description: The native range of this species is Pakistan to Sakhalin and Indo-China. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda javanica
children.description: The native range of this species is Arunachal Pradesh to S. China and W. & C. Malesia. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Osmunda lancea
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda pilosa
children.description: The native range of this species is Himalaya to S. Russian Far East and C. Japan. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda regalis
children.description: The native range of this species is Macaronesia, Europe to Medit. and Iran, Trop. & S. Africa, Madagascar, Réunion, Mauritius. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda spectabilis
children.description: The native range of this species is New World. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Osmunda vachellii
children.description: The native range of this species is S. China to Pen. Malaysia.

children.name: Osmundastrum
children.description: Osmundastrum — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Osmundastrum cinnamomeum
children.description: The native range of this species is New World, Arunachal Pradesh to Russian Far East and N. Indo-China. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
